messages:
Sam: Heads-up — cost-alert flagged a ~38% drop in RI utilization for eu-west-1 p4d family this billing period. Cost Explorer shows reservation covered hours down from 92% -> 58%. Anyone else seeing this?
Marta: Saw it too. Confirmed a cluster of training jobs shifted zones last week, lots of spot fallbacks reported.
Priya: Quick triage: ran our reservation mapping script. Shows ~12 instances in eu-west-1 missing the `reservation_owner` tag so they aren't being attributed to the RI pool. Ran: `./tools/ri-check --region eu-west-1 --family p4d --output short`.
Sam: Can you paste the sample output?
Priya: Sure — sample lines:
```
instance-0a1b2c3d4e  p4d.24xlarge  tags: {}
instance-0f9e8d7c6b  p4d.24xlarge  tags: {team:ml}
instance-0123abcd45  p4d.16xlarge  tags: {reservation_owner:eng-infra}
```
Note: mixed sizes. Some 16x are tagged, several 24x are untagged.
Liam: I remembered a terraform change on Tuesday — we updated `instance_profile` across the training module which also changed the module path. The tagging module depends on that path; looks like it stopped adding `reservation_owner`. PR #1124 touches this.
Finance: FYI, if these hours are truly orphaned we can submit an exchange/reallocation request on the next reservation window, but we need >72h of orphaned usage and a remediation plan.
Kai: I'll stand up a quick lambda to backfill tags based on inventory join (instance_id -> launch_metadata). ETA 30m for staging dry-run.
Marta: Also check whether teams intentionally moved to p4d.24xlarge — our existing RIs cover p4d.16xlarge equivalence only, so instance-family/size drift will leave uncovered hours even if tagged.
Sam: Action list: (1) Priya to finish mapping & produce CSV of untagged instance_ids (2) Kai to dry-run lambda tagger in staging (3) Liam to revert/adapt TF tagging module or add a compatibility hook (4) Finance to hold exchange request until we confirm persistent orphan hours >72h. Ping @Finance in 24h with updated numbers.
Priya: Running the inventory query now:
```
SELECT instance_id FROM inventory
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND NOT json_extract(tags, '$.reservation_owner') IS NOT NULL;
```
Expecting CSV in ~12 minutes.
Kai: Deployed tagger to staging. Dry-run: `tagger.run --dry-run --limit 10` showed 9/10 would get `reservation_owner=eng-infra`. No errors. Will coordinate prod rollout after Priya's CSV.
Sam: If prod tagging fixes attribution, re-run the utilization report and check delta. If still low, then we have to review instance size drift vs RI family.
Billing Bot: Automated report attached — Utilization delta: -34% for p4d in eu-west-1 between 2026-02-01 and 2026-03-01. Details: https://billing.internal/reports/1945123456
Marta: Filing a follow-up ticket INFRA-4792 and adding owners.
Sam: Thanks everyone — please update the ticket when you have results. :thumbsup:
